# Decoder vectors

`ha-asc-apache-license.ha` is the public `tests/ha/asc.ha` vector from
unarc-rs, commit `b017fed390a8021faa198d0c842c95d13ecbaf6d`.
SHA256: `c6a8a075559f457b595ba55f452455b698b5217e3d38572b6ca8f9026a9a066d`.
Its only member is the Apache 2.0 license (11357 bytes, CRC32 0x7b5d04bc).
It is test data and is not included in application archives.
